files.file: New: custom-property light/dark theme, 600px column, sticky header, pill buttons, hover only in (hover:hover)+(pointer:fine), two-tone focus ring, :active, :has() selected photo, aria-busy spinner, reduced-motion static ring, error boxes with glyph + "Error:" prefix.
setBusy/clearBusy (disabled + aria-busy + "Saving..."/"Deleting..." labels, restored in finally); what-failed + next-step error messages with known-detail hints, network and load wording.

tests.test: Manual CDP screenshots against temp-path server (light, dark, dark edit mode with checked photo and focus ring, 360px); scrollWidth 360 at 360px. Full criteria matrix not scripted.

commands_run.command: temp-DB uvicorn + node CDP screenshot script in scratchpad

design_decisions.decision: Light primary #1d9bf0 with dark text #0f1419 (6.1:1) rather than white text (3.0:1); dark primary #1a8cd8 so white focus ring has >=3:1 against the fill.
Focus ring color is #0f1419 (light) / #fff (dark), 3px with 3px offset gap, rather than blue ring which fails 3:1 against blue fill.
Selected photo text cue via ::after "will be removed" in CSS (no JS), rather than changing label text in app.js.
Busy/disabled both set; disabled-without-busy dimmed to 0.5 opacity, busy keeps opacity 1.
Body is the 600px column (with side borders) so sticky header lives inside it; rejected full-width wrapper element since index.html is unchanged.
Hint matching by case-insensitive substring of detail, rather than exact equality, to survive suffixes.

implementation.self_critique: Contrast ratios computed by hand, not by script; muted dark #8b98a5 and danger colors on tinted backgrounds unverified numerically. Busy-state, error text and Tab order were not exercised with CDP intercepts. :active hover override relies on specificity ordering.
